design_note: Anxiolytic prompt set for auditing text-to-music models. Categories mirror common consumer use (sleep, anxiety relief, meditation, study calm) plus matched control prompts (neutral and high-arousal). 10 naturalistic paraphrases per category: inference is clustered by prompt, so prompt-level n drives statistical power, not clips-per-prompt.

notes: 70 prompts x 12 gens = 840 clips at 45 s (matches DEAM excerpt length -> no train/score duration mismatch). Audited model: stabilityai/stable-audio-3-medium (2B DiT latent diffusion, May 2025, Stability AI Community License; substitution from stable-audio-open-1.0 decided by Stone 2026-08-30). Inference: cluster bootstrap by prompt.
